decisions.rationale: It reports Method M+ versus CERT-ED but omits Method M’s lower Yelp and higher SpamAssassin/LUN cardinalities, materially under-covering the finding’s entities and scope.
It mentions Method M’s disadvantage only on Yelp and LUN, omitting SpamAssassin and the finding that Method M+ was below CERT-ED on every dataset.
It correctly compares Method M with CERT-ED across all datasets but omits the required finding that Method M also exceeded RanMASK on all three.
“Did not consistently outperform” understates the universal result: both Method M and M+ had lower clean accuracy than CERT-ED on every dataset.
